summary: This is a Form 6-K filed by Western Copper & Gold Corporation, a Canadian foreign private issuer, reporting a material change dated June 15, 2026. The company announced a further strengthening of its strategic partnership with Mitsubishi Materials Corporation by entering into an amended and restated investor rights agreement, extending rights until November 30, 2028, contingent on Mitsubishi Materials acquiring 1.2 million common shares through open market purchases, bringing its ownership back to ~5%. No new shares are issued, so no dilution. This is a routine strategic alliance update, not a special situation requiring classification as an acquisition or other event.
